content.title: High schooler Mason Howell gets full Augusta experience in Masters debut
content.text: GolfSouth Georgia high school student played alongside defending Masters champion Rory McIlroy in Thursday’s opening round at Augusta National. Mason Howell loses his hat teeing off on first hole during first round of the Masters Tournament, at Augusta National Golf Club, Thursday, April 9, 2026, in Augusta, Ga. (Jason Getz/AJC)AUGUSTA — Mason Howell needed just two shots Thursday at the Masters to experience Augusta National in full.Howell, an 18-year-old from Thomasville a month from graduating high school, pulled his opening tee shot left to the adjacent No. 9 fairway.
